derivation.behavior: Queue arbitration is deterministic and starvation-resistant.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go combines priority, fairness, dependencies, capacity, retry deadlines and runtime holds.

input.scenario: scheduler stress arbitration with fake clock

checks: Runnable set is stable across deterministic replay with the same clock and input ordering.
Priority and queue position are deterministic tie breakers.
Fairness aging contributes a bounded score boost so older lower priority work can advance without randomization.
Dependency, retry deadline, runtime condition, global capacity, host capacity, and queue concurrency holds are explained per candidate.
